budget_policy: Starting gate, not a target size: first_js_decoded_bytes is ~25% headroom over the initial 2026-08-29 measured_decoded_bytes, meant to catch regressions from today's baseline, not to bless that baseline as acceptable. Ratchet these down as each route gets dedicated budget-diet work; do not read 1.2 MB as interview's intended ceiling.
scope_note: KAZI-654's AC named 4 routes (space, interview, english, cv) — the ones with the worst recent perf incidents. KAZI-1171 removed the english route (the /english page is gone), so 3 remain. Hub and login are intentionally NOT gated here: Hub shares the same (workspace) layout tax as these routes but has no route-owned budget of its own yet, and login is a separate first-load graph nobody has profiled for a budget yet. Clinic (home + /chat) already has its own gate — scripts/check-clinic-js-budget.mjs (KAZI-567) — kept separate because it scans multiple candidate page keys, not one. See KAZI-654 for scope discussion.
